projects.name: airwatch
projects.summary: Hyperlocal air quality for Indian cities. Finds the hotspots a city average hides, traces them to likely sources with wind data, and alerts the responsible district.

projects.name: AUV-3D
projects.summary: Interactive 3D digital twin of an adaptive, software-defined sonar transmitter payload for underwater vehicles, with signal, power and frequency-plan views.

projects.name: diode-sentinel
projects.summary: Passive, real-time AI/ML threat detection on one-way IP traffic. Read-only with no decryption, explainable alerts, and a hash-chained evidence ledger.

projects.name: Face-Detector
projects.summary: Detects and encodes a face, finds a genuine matching post on social media, and anchors it on Ethereum Sepolia as tamper-evident proof anyone can re-verify.

projects.name: Sonic-Rag
projects.summary: Voice-enabled Indic RAG over 194,904 vectors in English, Hindi and Tamil. 48 ms P50 retrieval on CPU, and a grounding threshold that refuses rather than invents.
